statements: During normal operation, the purpose of the HMMWV venting system is to allow air to enter the engine compartment.
During normal operation, air entering the HMMWV engine compartment prevents a vacuum from forming.
A vacuum in the HMMWV engine compartment could impede engine performance.
A vacuum in the HMMWV engine compartment could cause fuel system issues.
During deep-water fording, the HMMWV venting system helps equalize pressure within the vehicle.
During deep-water fording, the HMMWV venting system allows air to flow in and maintain proper system pressure.
During deep-water fording, maintaining proper system pressure prevents water from being siphoned into the HMMWV engine or fuel system.
During deep-water fording, the HMMWV venting system prevents hydrolocking.
During deep-water fording, the HMMWV venting system ensures the engine can continue to operate safely and efficiently.
